note: CB-c1: parsers/code/go/src/lib.rs emit_route_from_call returns unless the receiver is a plain identifier, so a router held on a struct field (`s.router.GET`, `s.v1.GET`) mints nothing. A field's group prefix assigned in the same file (`s.v1 = s.router.Group("/v1")`, s typed by `s := &Server{..}`) prefixes its routes. `s.client.Get("/upstream")` is an HTTP client call, not a route (precision).
